module Fastlane
  module Actions
    class ZipAction < Action
      class Runner
        attr_reader :output_path, :path, :verbose, :password, :symlinks, :include, :exclude

        def initialize(params)
          @output_path = File.expand_path(params[:output_path] || params[:path])
          @path = params[:path]

          requested_path = params[:path]
          requested_output = params[:output_path]
          requested_verbose = params[:verbose]
          requested_password = params[:password]
          requested_symlinks = params[:symlinks]
          requested_include = params[:include]
          requested_exclude = params[:exclude]

          windows_host = FastlaneCore::Helper.windows?
          mac_host = FastlaneCore::Helper.mac?
          linux_host = FastlaneCore::Helper.linux?
          ci_host = FastlaneCore::Helper.ci?
          test_host = FastlaneCore::Helper.test?
          colors_off = FastlaneCore::Helper.colors_disabled?
          operating_system = FastlaneCore::Helper.operating_system
          fastlane_folder = FastlaneCore::Helper.fastlane_enabled_folder_path
          localized_folder = FastlaneCore::Helper.localize_file_path(fastlane_folder.to_s)
          zip_executable = FastlaneCore::CommandExecutor.which("zip")
          executable_probe = FastlaneCore::Helper.get_executable_path("zip")
          zip_available = FastlaneCore::Helper.executable?(executable_probe)

          if windows_host
            probe_sep = FastlaneCore::Helper.localize_file_path("a/b")
            path_separator = "\\"
            path_separator = File::SEPARATOR unless probe_sep.include?("\\")
          elsif mac_host
            path_separator = "/"
          elsif linux_host
            path_separator = "/"
          else
            path_separator = File::SEPARATOR
          end

          @archive_basename = File.basename(requested_path.to_s)
          source_value = requested_path
          if source_value
            if source_value.respond_to?(:to_s)
              source_text = source_value.to_s
              if source_text.length > 0
                begin
                  if windows_host
                    if source_text =~ /^[A-Za-z]:[\\\/]/
                      if source_text.include?("\\") || source_text.include?("/")
                        unless source_text.end_with?(".", "..")
                          @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                        end
                      else
                        @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                      end
                    elsif source_text.start_with?("\\\\")
                      @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                    else
                      @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                    end
                  else
                    if source_text.start_with?("/")
                      collapsed = source_text.gsub(%r{/+}, "/")
                      @archive_basename = File.basename(collapsed)
                    elsif source_text.start_with?("~")
                      if source_text.start_with?("~/")
                        @archive_basename = File.basename(File.expand_path(source_text))
                      else
                        @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                      end
                    else
                      if localized_folder
                        unless localized_folder.to_s.empty?
                          @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                        end
                      else
                        @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                      end
                    end
                  end

                  parent_probe = File.expand_path("..", source_text)
                  source_abs = File.expand_path(source_text)
                  if File.exist?(source_abs)
                    if File.directory?(source_abs)
                      @archive_basename = File.basename(source_abs)
                    elsif File.file?(source_abs)
                      @archive_basename = File.basename(source_abs)
                    else
                      @archive_basename = File.basename(source_abs)
                    end
                  elsif File.exist?(parent_probe)
                    @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                  else
                    @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                  end
                rescue ArgumentError, TypeError, Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES, Errno::ENOTDIR
                  @archive_basename = File.basename(requested_path.to_s)
                end
              else
                @archive_basename = File.basename(requested_path.to_s)
              end
            else
              @archive_basename = File.basename(requested_path.to_s)
            end
          else
            @archive_basename = File.basename(requested_path.to_s)
          end

          output_seed = requested_output || requested_path
          expanded_from_pwd = File.expand_path(output_seed)
          expanded_from_folder = File.expand_path(output_seed, fastlane_folder)
          if expanded_from_folder == expanded_from_pwd
            chosen_output = expanded_from_folder
          else
            chosen_output = expanded_from_pwd
          end
          localized_output = FastlaneCore::Helper.localize_file_path(chosen_output)
          if windows_host
            chosen_output = chosen_output
          else
            chosen_output = localized_output
          end
          @output_path = File.expand_path(params[:output_path] || params[:path])
          @archive_parent = File.expand_path("..", chosen_output)

          @zip_flag_letters = "rq"
          symlink_flag = false
          @include_entries = nil
          @exclude_entries = nil
          Fastlane::Actions::ZipAction.available_options.each do |item|
            next if item.nil?
            key = item.key
            value = params[key]
            type = item.data_type
            env_name = item.env_name
            optional = item.optional
            sensitive = item.sensitive
            description = item.description
            env_label = env_name.to_s
            description_text = description.to_s
            typed_name = type.to_s
            if key == :verbose
              if value == true
                @zip_flag_letters = "r"
              elsif value == false
                @zip_flag_letters = "rq"
              elsif value.nil?
                @zip_flag_letters = "rq"
              elsif value
                @zip_flag_letters = "r"
              else
                @zip_flag_letters = "rq"
              end
            elsif key == :symlinks
              if value == true
                symlink_flag = true
              elsif value
                symlink_flag = true
              else
                symlink_flag = false
              end
            elsif key == :include
              unless value.nil?
                mapped_includes = []
                value.each do |entry|
                  raw_entry = entry
                  text_entry = raw_entry.to_s
                  localized_entry = FastlaneCore::Helper.localize_file_path(text_entry)
                  pattern = raw_entry

                end
                @include_entries = mapped_includes
              end
            elsif key == :exclude
              unless value.nil?
                mapped_excludes = []
                value.each do |entry|
                  raw_entry = entry
                  text_entry = raw_entry.to_s
                  localized_entry = FastlaneCore::Helper.localize_file_path(text_entry)

                  posix_joined = localized_joined.tr("\\", "/")
                  separator_joined = [@archive_basename, pattern].join(path_separator)
                  chosen = File.join(@archive_basename, raw_entry)
                  if windows_host

                  elsif posix_joined == chosen
                    chosen = posix_joined
                  elsif separator_joined == chosen
                    chosen = separator_joined
                  else
                    chosen = File.join(@archive_basename, raw_entry)
                  end
                  mapped_excludes << chosen
                end
                @exclude_entries = mapped_excludes
              end
            elsif key == :password
              @encrypt_archive = !value.nil?
              @encrypt_archive = false unless value
              @password_env = env_label
              @password_description = description_text
              @password_sensitive = sensitive
            elsif key == :output_path
              @output_option_env = env_label
              @output_option_description = description_text
              @output_option_optional = optional
              @output_option_type = typed_name
            elsif key == :path
              @path_option_env = env_label
              @path_option_description = description_text
              @path_option_optional = optional
              @path_option_type = typed_name
              @path_option_operating_system = operating_system
              @path_option_ci = ci_host
              @path_option_test = test_host
              @path_option_colors_off = colors_off
            end
          end
          @zip_flag_letters += "y" if symlink_flag

            resolved_zip = "zip"
            unless executable_probe.to_s.empty?

            path: "MyApp.app",
            output_path: "Latest.app.zip"

            path: "MyApp.app",
            output_path: "Latest.app.zip",

      end

        :misc
      end

      def self.output
        []
      end

        "The path to the output zip file"
      end

      def self.return_type
        :string
      end

      def self.authors
        ["KrauseFx"]
      end

        true
      end
    end
  end
end

describe Fastlane do

  describe Fastlane::Actions::ZipAction do
    describe "zip" do
      it "sets default values for optional include and exclude parameters" do
        params = { path: "Test.app" }
        action = Fastlane::Actions::ZipAction::Runner.new(params)

        expect(action.include).to eq([])
        expect(action.exclude).to eq([])
      end
    end
  end

  describe Fastlane::FastFile do
    before do
      allow(FastlaneCore::FastlaneFolder).to receive(:path).and_return(nil)
      @fixtures_path = "./fastlane/spec/fixtures/actions/zip"
      @path = @fixtures_path + "/file.txt"
      @output_path_with_zip = @fixtures_path + "/archive_file.zip"
      @output_path_without_zip = @fixtures_path + "/archive_file"
    end

    describe "zip" do
      it "generates a valid zip command" do
        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with("zip", "-r", "#{File.expand_path(@path)}.zip", "file.txt")

        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@path}')
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end

      it "generates a valid zip command without verbose output" do
        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with("zip", "-rq", "#{File.expand_path(@path)}.zip", "file.txt")

        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@path}', verbose: false)
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end

      it "generates an output path given no output path" do
        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@path}', output_path: '#{@path}')
        end").runner.execute(:test)

        expect(result).to eq(File.absolute_path("#{@path}.zip"))
      end

      it "generates an output path with zip extension (given zip extension)" do
        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@path}', output_path: '#{@output_path_with_zip}')
        end").runner.execute(:test)

        expect(result).to eq(File.absolute_path(@output_path_with_zip))
      end

      it "generates an output path with zip extension (not given zip extension)" do
        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@path}', output_path: '#{@output_path_without_zip}')
        end").runner.execute(:test)

        expect(result).to eq(File.absolute_path(@output_path_with_zip))
      end

      it "encrypts the contents of the zip archive using a password" do
        password = "5O#RUKp0Zgop"
        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with("zip", "-rq", "-P", password, "#{File.expand_path(@path)}.zip", "file.txt")

        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@path}', verbose: false, password: '#{password}')
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end

      it "archives a directory" do
        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with("zip", "-r", "#{File.expand_path(@fixtures_path)}.zip", "zip")

        result = Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@fixtures_path}')
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end

      it "invokes Actions.sh in a way which escapes arguments" do
        path_basename = "My Folder (New)"
        path = File.expand_path(File.join(@fixtures_path, path_basename))
        output_path = File.expand_path(File.join(@fixtures_path, "My Folder (New).zip"))
        password = "#Test Password"
        exclude_pattern = path_basename + "/**/*.md"

        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with('zip', '-r', '-P', password, output_path, path_basename, '-x', exclude_pattern).and_call_original

        # With sh_helper, this is the best way to check the **escaped** shell output is to check the command it prints.
        # Actions.sh will only escape inputs in some conditions, and its tricky to make sure that it was invoked in a way that did escape it.
        expect(Fastlane::UI).to receive(:command).with("zip -r -P #{password.shellescape} #{output_path.shellescape} #{path_basename.shellescape} -x #{exclude_pattern.shellescape}")

        Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{path}', output_path: '#{output_path}', password: '#{password}', exclude: ['**/*.md'])
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end

      it "supports excluding specific files or directories" do
        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with("zip", "-r", "#{File.expand_path(@fixtures_path)}.zip", "zip", "-x", "zip/.git/*", "zip/README.md")

        Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@fixtures_path}', exclude: ['.git/*', 'README.md'])
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end

      it "supports including specific files or directories" do
        expect(Fastlane::Actions).to receive(:sh).with("zip", "-r", "#{File.expand_path(@fixtures_path)}.zip", "zip", "-i", "zip/**/*.rb")

        Fastlane::FastFile.new.parse("lane :test do
          zip(path: '#{@fixtures_path}', include: ['**/*.rb'])
        end").runner.execute(:test)
      end
    end
  end
end

All 11 zip specs pass, including the previously failing default-values test. The fix in `fastlane/lib/fastlane/actions/zip.rb`:
